pipeline.title: How Imaco Launches Your Career
pipeline.subtitle: A structured 4-step pathway from zero foundation to certified agency professional or agency founder.
pipeline.step1Desc: Practical, zero-fluff training led by agency practitioners in marketing, AI, video, design, and code.
pipeline.step2Desc: Top students apply for our rigorous 3-month unpaid agency internship (5 interns per cohort).
pipeline.step3Desc: Execute real campaigns, brand designs, and AI automations for live corporate clients in Ethiopia.
pipeline.step4Desc: Receive an officially verified certificate, join the Imaco team full-time, or launch your own agency.
